Name: Rubber Ducky Crimes
Author: 7thAxis
Description:
Welcome to the world of [i]Rubber Ducky Crimes[/i], inspired by the yee old json assets shuffle.

Here's the what this very good mod i made in some kind of episode contains:

[u][i][b][size=4]🦆 Adds 3 new game changing recipes! 🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u]

[u]Rubber Ducky [/u]
[list]
[*]Create a fully functional squeaking rubber ducky!
[*]Requires x1 Duck Egg, x1 Trash and x1 Solar Essence
[/list][u]Rubber Ducky Infuser[/u]
[list]
[*]Infuse rubber ducks with the colors and names of pretty much any item you can hold over your head.
[*]Requires x5 Rubber Duckies, x5 Gold Bars, x1 Fire Quartz and x1 Life Elixir
[/list][u]MEEPS (TM)[/u]
[list]
[*]Legally distinct marshmallow? candies that grow more rubber ducks!
[*]Requires x1 Sugar and x1 Rubber Duck
[*]Can also be created by placing a rubber duck in a seed maker
[/list]
[size=4][b][u][i][u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u] Rubber duck squeaks on use[u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u][/i][/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Right click to grace your ears with the rubber ducky's Brilliant Squeaker.
[*]There's no limit to the squeaking. Try holding right click!
[/list][size=3][b][u][i]
[/i][/u][/b][/size][size=4][b][u][i][u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u] MEEPS (TM) grow unique Rubber Ducky crops! [u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u][/i][/u][/b][/size][list]
[*]They grow into 141 unique colors of rubber ducky
[*]Yes they do fill your inventory individually. This is a feature, not a bug.
[i][u][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][/u][/i][/list][i][u][b][size=4][u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u] Create NEW rubber duckies with the Rubber Duck Infuser! [u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u][/size][/b][/u][/i][list]
[*]Uses (1) rubber duck as fuel to create a NEW colored rubber duck based on an object of your choice
[*]If you feed Rubber Duck Infuser a rubber duck as both fuel and a rubber duck as the item, your duck gets friends.
[*]If you feed Rubber Duck infuser an explosive, you'll get an explosive rubber duck. Does what it says on the tin.
[*]Too many MEEPS (TM)? Infuse them with a Rubber Ducky to make EDIBLE giant MEEPS (TM)!
[*]Infuse your Rubber Ducky with a Rubber Duck Infuser to create an abomination.
[*]This machine actively makes your input item sell price worse. This is a feature, not a bug.
[*]This machine can and will eat items like the ones from birdie's quest. This is a also feature, not a bug.
[/list]
[i][u][b][size=4][u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u] Sick of your Rubber Duckies? Melt them in a furnace like the monster you are. [u][i][b][size=4]🦆[/size][/b][/i][/u][/size][/b][/u][/i][list]
[*]Melting a Rubber Ducky turns it into a Melted Rubber Ducky. Such cruelty.
[*]Melting a Melted Rubber Ducky turns it into trash. :(
[*]Trying to infuse a melted rubber ducky with a normal rubber ducky only creates sadness.
[/list]
This message has been brought to you by Oh God I Have A Migraine.

-> Void Rubber Ducky (void squeaker)
-> Mayo Rubber Ducky (drinkable)
-> Tortilla Rubber Ducky (edible)
-> Pufferfish Rubber Ducky (squeaker)
-> Ancient Fruit Rubber Ducky (squeaker)
